dessin: Three small software application windows side by side in one horizontal row, with equal small gaps, all the same size and aligned on top and bottom, the row filling the frame; each window is a flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline and sharp square corners, slightly taller than wide, with a thin title bar along its top edge; each title bar contains only two tiny square buttons at its right end, no text. Each window shows a different simple work area drawn in thin ink lines: the left window, three small boxes linked by lines like a diagram; the middle window, a small table grid; the right window, a simple line drawing (a closed outline shape crossed by one line). Nothing outside the three windows.
